Q3 Financial Performance Report
Total company revenue for Q3 reached $18.4M, a 12% increase over Q2. Growth was driven
primarily by the North America and EMEA regions, which grew 15% and 9% respectively. Operating
expenses increased 6% quarter-over-quarter, driven by higher marketing spend ahead of the
holiday season. Gross margin held steady at 61%.
The finance team is finalizing the annual budget for next fiscal year, with department heads
expected to submit expense forecasts by the end of this month. Any capital expenditure request
above $50,000 requires CFO approval and a documented business case. Employees seeking
reimbursement for business-related purchases should route requests through the finance portal, not
through HR.
